answer.reason: The verses tell of Jeremiah's deeds and sufferings at length, so three chief events can be drawn from the narrative chapters.

clauses.english: had Baruch write his words on a roll
clauses.quote: Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the LORD

clauses.english: was cast into a dungeon of mire and drawn up by Ebedmelech
clauses.quote: cast him into the dungeon of Malchiah the son of Hammelech

clauses.english: was taken out of the court of the prison when Jerusalem fell
clauses.quote: took Jeremiah out of the court of the prison

doubts: MAT 16:14 (Jeremias) and MAT 27:9 (Jeremy) are quotations or opinions about the prophet, not events of his life, so I left them out.
Many other deeds are told (stocks, trial, Egypt, letter to Babylon); I chose three chief ones.
